title: StartServiceRequest
description: Request to start the authorized service, written by the app to the station on BLE characteristic FFF3, inside the channel. It names the bay and the service of the session's authorization; the station resolves the program from its own bindings (profiles/offline/ble-session.md §1).

bayId.description: The bay of the session's authorization - the OfflineAuthRequest's, or the ServerSignedAuth's signed claim.

serviceId.description: The service of the session's authorization - the OfflineAuthRequest's, or the ServerSignedAuth's signed claim. The station resolves the program to run from the bindings of the catalog it holds.

requestedDurationSeconds.description: Requested service duration in seconds. Above the session's authorized duration it is refused with 3010, never reduced (profiles/offline/ble-session.md §1).
